hero.eyebrow: TRIPS AND PREPAID PAYMENT COURIER, ALL IN ONE APP
hero.description: Book a reliable trip or use Prepaid Payment Courier for customer orders that have already been paid for. Built for merchants and business owners, Rover makes pickup, live tracking and delivery confirmation simple.
hero.appStoreAriaLabel: Download Rover on the App Store
hero.phoneImageAlt: Rover mobile application showing the driver selection screen

about.introduction: Rover supports everyday passenger trips and prepaid-order delivery for merchants and business owners. From requesting a driver or courier to tracking the journey and confirming arrival, every step is designed to be simple, visible and reliable.
about.journeyTitle: Move through your day with confidence.
about.requestRideDescription: Find a nearby driver and travel comfortably to your selected destination.
about.sendPackageDescription: Arrange delivery for customer orders that have already been paid for, without managing cash collection during delivery.
about.sendPackageAriaLabel: Arrange a Prepaid Payment Courier delivery with Rover
about.trackEveryStepDescription: Follow your driver, trip or prepaid courier delivery directly from the application.
about.safetyDescription: Clear trip and delivery information, live progress and dependable support help you move with confidence.
about.flexibleDescription: Use Rover for personal trips or to deliver prepaid customer orders for your business.

features.introduction: Whether you are booking a passenger trip or using Prepaid Payment Courier for a customer order, Rover gives you the tools to request, manage and track everything from one place.

services.label: TWO SERVICES
services.title: Trips or Prepaid Payment Courier, whenever you need it.
services.description: Choose passenger transportation for yourself or arrange prepaid-order delivery for your business from the same Rover application.

tracking.label: LIVE PROGRESS
tracking.title: Know where your driver or courier is.
tracking.description: See the route, estimated arrival time and current trip or delivery status in real time.

clearPricing.title: Clear pricing
clearPricing.description: Review estimated trip fares or courier delivery pricing before confirming your request.

fastMatching.title: Fast driver and courier matching
fastMatching.description: Rover quickly searches for a suitable nearby driver for your trip or prepaid delivery.

safety.title: Safety and visibility built in
safety.description: Driver or courier details, route information and live progress help you stay informed.

flexibleDeliveries.title: Built for prepaid business orders
flexibleDeliveries.description: Designed for merchants, online sellers and business owners delivering customer orders that have already been paid for.

howItWorks.introduction: Choose Trips or Prepaid Payment Courier, confirm the details, get matched with a nearby driver or courier and follow the journey from beginning to end.

locations.title: Set your locations
locations.description: Add the trip pickup and destination, or your business pickup location and the customer's delivery address.

service.title: Choose your service
service.description: Select Trips for passenger transport or Prepaid Payment Courier for an order that has already been paid for.

matching.title: Get matched
matching.description: Rover finds a nearby driver or courier and shows their information before pickup.

tracking.title: Track every step
tracking.description: Follow the trip or prepaid order live until the passenger or order reaches the destination.

preview.roverOnWay: Your Rover courier is on the way
preview.arrivingApproximately: Arriving for pickup in approximately 2 minutes

security.introduction: Rover helps passengers, merchants and business owners stay informed throughout every trip and prepaid courier delivery. Clear driver, courier and journey details keep you aware of what is happening, while the Rover support team remains ready to assist.

assurance.label: BUILT AROUND YOUR CONFIDENCE
assurance.title: Help is always close when you need it.
assurance.description: Open the in-app support page, explain what happened and connect with a team prepared to guide you through the next step.

visibleJourneys.title: Visible trips and deliveries
visibleJourneys.description: View driver or courier, route and journey information so you always know what is happening.

protectedInformation.title: Protected information
protectedInformation.description: Rover is designed to keep your account, trip and delivery details handled securely.

supportWithinReach.title: Support within reach
supportWithinReach.description: Contact the Rover support team directly whenever you need help with a trip or prepaid courier delivery.

supportBanner.label: ROVER CUSTOMER SUPPORT
supportBanner.description: A real team, ready when something happens.

signup.introduction: Join the Rover updates list for important announcements, new features, service-area launches and useful news about Trips and Prepaid Payment Courier.

serviceAreas.title: New service areas
serviceAreas.description: Be the first to know when Rover Trips or Prepaid Payment Courier reaches a new location.

productUpdates.title: Product updates
productUpdates.description: Discover new trip and merchant courier features as they launch.

safetyNews.title: Safety and support news
safetyNews.description: Receive useful information for passengers, merchants and business owners.

form.title: Get the latest from Rover.
form.description: Useful updates only. No unnecessary messages and no clutter.
form.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
form.successMessage: You are now on the Rover updates list.
form.privacy: Your email will only be used for Rover news and updates.

footer.description: Rover makes transportation and business delivery easier by helping users book trips while enabling merchants and business owners to deliver prepaid customer orders from one convenient platform.
